title: Alaska Native Vietnam Era Veterans Land Allotment Extension Act of 2025
official_summary:
Alaska Native Vietnam Era Veterans Land Allotment Extension Act of 2025

This act extends for an additional five years the time period during which an eligible Alaska Native veteran may apply for a land allotment under the Alaska Native Vietnam Era Veterans Land Allotment Program. The program makes Alaska Native veterans who served in the Armed Forces in Vietnam between August 5, 1964, and December 31, 1971, or their heirs eligible to receive up to 160 acres of federal land in Alaska.

Under the current program, the Department of the Interior's Bureau of Land Management may accept applications through December 29, 2025. This act extends this time period for an additional five years to December 29, 2030.

summary.headline: Law gives eligible Alaska Native Vietnam-era veterans and their heirs five more years, until December 29, 2030, to apply for federal land.
summary.what_it_does: This law extends the deadline to apply for land under the Alaska Native Vietnam Era Veterans Land Allotment Program. Under the program, eligible veterans or their heirs can receive up to 160 acres of federal land in Alaska. The Bureau of Land Management had been set to stop accepting applications on December 29, 2025. The new deadline is December 29, 2030.

who_it_affects.group: Alaska Native veterans who served in the Armed Forces in Vietnam between August 5, 1964, and December 31, 1971
who_it_affects.how: They have five more years to apply for up to 160 acres of federal land in Alaska.

who_it_affects.group: Heirs of eligible Alaska Native Vietnam-era veterans
who_it_affects.how: They also have until December 29, 2030, to apply for land on behalf of the veteran.

who_it_affects.group: The Bureau of Land Management in the Department of the Interior
who_it_affects.how: It must keep accepting and processing land allotment applications for five more years.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 26, 2025; the application deadline moves from December 29, 2025, to December 29, 2030.
